title: 0236 - spf(p+2) -> (L, L_next) transfer matrix at 1e8: the pair family still owns the next-gap decile (MARSHALLED, band discipline), but spf(p+2) carries a small REAL conditional signal: gain(S) = +0.08774 nats/step vs the within-L shuffle null +0.00132 +/- 0.00003 (z = +2573); strictly ordered LANE (+0.0517) < S (+0.0877). All five 0232/0234 structure anchors re-exact at 1e8: s=3 <=> left lane {1,7,13,19} (share 1.000000 both directions, 2,875,733), TW lanes never-3 with exactly 1,224 distinct spf values, parity theorem 0 violations / 535,058 adjacent pairs, s=5 lane {1,13} x2.18 (stable from x2.225 @1e7). No RH claim
body: 0236 runs the 0234 follow-up (b) instrument: given the current gap length L_g (the pair family's full state per 0233), does s = spf(p+2) add information about the NEXT gap? Population: X = 1e8, XLO = 1e5, 5,751,861 gaps with both L_g and L_{g+1} (max L_g = 219 in-run; population L >= 2 restricted to 5,312,773 gaps where p+2 is an in-gap composite; distinct s = 1,225, max s = 9949, min s = 3 since p+2 is odd). Target: 10 quantile deciles of L_{g+1}. Ladder (nats/step NLL): PRIOR 2.26957; PAIR P(.|L_g) 2.21172 (baseline; exact L_g values 3..61 + rest, 31 buckets); PAIR+LANE (+ left lane p mod 24, 24 classes) 2.16001; PAIR+S (+ s, 128 most frequent values + rest) 2.12398, with thin (L,s) cells (< 30 samples) falling back to the PAIR row (documented rule, applied identically in the null). gain(S) = +0.08774 nats/step, gain(LANE) = +0.05171 - strictly ordered: the finer class carries more. Protocol-correct null: 200 permutations of the s labels WITHIN each L_g stratum (preserves P(s|L_g) and every (L_g,s) cell mass exactly; breaks only the (L_g,s) -> target association; the refit table is re-estimated per shuffle, so the floor includes the refit advantage): null gains +0.00132 +/- 0.00003 (200 permutations, seed 18). Observed z = +2573: the gain is overwhelmingly real, and because the null shuffles within L, the signal cannot be carried by the L-dependent marginal of s - it is genuinely conditional. Band discipline (|gain| < 0.2 nats/step = MARSHALLED, per 0225/0228/0233): +0.088 is INSIDE the band - VERDICT MARSHALLED at the decile level: the pair family still owns the next-gap decile; s adds ~4% of the PAIR NLL, not a new predictor; no capacity model warranted (0233's GRU-LOCK 2.63233 / GRU-FREE 2.87944 remain far above). But the ceiling is no longer strict: it is 'MARSHALLED-but-real'. Exact-structure anchors re-verified at 1e8 (0232/0234 side; all five EXACT or stable): T1+T2 the bijection spf(p+2)=3 <=> left prime lane p mod 24 in {1,7,13,19}: share = 1.000000 in both directions over 2,875,733 OT-lane gaps (arithmetic: p mod 3 = 1 forces 3 | p+2 and p+2 is odd, so spf = 3 exactly - proven by the mod-24/3 arithmetic, confirmed by count); T3 the TW lanes {5,11,17,23} never carry s = 3 (0/2,437,040) and carry exactly 1,224 distinct spf values (0234's count, reproduced to the integer); T4 the parity theorem (consecutive odd composites in one gap share no spf, since a common odd spf q would divide their difference 2): 0 violations over 535,058 adjacent pairs in the first 100k gaps - the tape-side statement of 0232's xrun = 1; T5 the s = 5 lane bias: share(s=5, lane(c_2) in {1,13}) = 0.5000 vs base 0.2294 = x2.18 (0231 A4 reported x2.225 at 1e7 - stable under a 10x scale-up). Within-pair-cell heterogeneity: for every mass pair L_g = 3..25 (119k..767k gaps), the sum over s-cells of chi2_d/(A-1) ranges 7.4e4..6.5e5 against an H0 expectation of ~120 (number of contributing s-cells) - a huge-n conditional redistribution whose NLL expression is exactly the +0.088 gain (not an inconsistency: with ~5.3M samples, a ~4% NLL shift produces 1e5-scale chi2). Instrument bugs caught and fixed during the run (recorded for the audit): a 92M re-index inside the parity loop (fixed by precomputing the composite-index array), an L-bucket sparse-vs-dense key collision, a fancy-index row/column swap in the NLL lookups, a 2-D bincount key used for a 3-D table in the null refit (the first null run's +2.44/-0.23 'gains' were artifacts of that and were superseded), and the off-by-one stratum labeling whose statistical effect is exactly the intended within-L-group shuffle. Closing statement: the decile side of the 0234 follow-ups is CLOSED - (L_g, s) is the honest conditional state for the next-gap decile, the pair family's ownership survives, and the small residual is arithmetic (s is a coarse label of the gap's local divisibility, which mildly conditions the next gap's available residues). Open: (a) sub-decile targets (exact L_next or 3-binned) where the 0.088 may concentrate; (b) the LEX-LEAN anchor of the T1-T5 anchor set (finite, exact, re-verified at 1e8 - frozen-table candidates in the WheelTile pattern). Off-board side-quest. No RH claim.
